title: CAS-07033 — The Assembly — Virgin Media 1
text:
Programme: The Assembly
Broadcast / VOD service: Virgin Media 1
Date broadcast or accessed: 19.01.2026
Statute and/or regulatory code: Section 46J(1)(a) of the Broadcasting Act 2009, as amended. Code of Programme Standards: Obligations 14.4 and 16.1
Short description: The Assembly is a factual entertainment programme in which autistic and neurodivergent adults ask questions of public figures. The complaint alleges that the programme promoted a debunked, scientifically discredited and unethical communication technique risking harm to viewers.
Outcome: Dismissed
Commission Decision: Dismiss the complaint pursuant to section 48(4)(a) of the Broadcasting Act 2009, as amended.
Commission Decision Date: 21.05.2026
